mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we have clear skies with a full moon visible over Verona City Hall. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 53 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona has released information regarding the upcoming Plan Commission meeting on November 4th. Proposals include the Ardent Glen development, site plans for 1979 Milky Way, and various certified survey maps. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled at Insight Wellness on October 26th, and trivia nights are happening at local favorites throughout next week.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers identified the driver after receiving reports of dangerous behavior, and although a traffic sign was struck, no injuries were reported.
Today's delicious flavor of the day at Culver's is Turtle. The restaurant is currently open for business until their closing time of 10:30 PM tonight.
